extDescription: Your whole Star Citizen hangar and buy back on one fast, searchable page – right on the RSI website. Your data stays local.

manager.title: Hangar Manager
manager.intro: An overview of your hangar. Use the refresh button at the top right to read the latest state from RSI.
manager.empty: RSI lists no pledges in your hangar.
manager.initialLoadText: The Hangar Manager reads your hangar, buy back and orders from RSI's website and keeps them in this browser. It doesn't do this on its own – start the first load here.
manager.initialLoadDuration: The first load can take a few seconds: about $1 for $2 pledges, about $3 for $4 pledges (hangar and buy back together). The progress shows on the refresh button at the top right.
manager.searchPlaceholder: Search titles, ships, pledge and order IDs …
manager.demoBadgeHint: Demo mode: a selection of your pledges with made-up pledge IDs. Turn it off in the settings.
manager.storeCreditHint: The account's store credit, as RSI shows it at the last refresh or check. Hidden while “Hide melt value” is on.

pledge.toggleDetails: Show or hide the contained items
pledge.protectedHint: RSI protects this pledge as your game access for $1. It can't be melted or gifted, but you can still upgrade it with CCUs.
pledge.protectedHintNoShip: RSI protects this pledge as your game access for $1. It can't be melted or gifted, and as it contains no ship, it can't be upgraded with CCUs either.
pledge.gamesLibraryHint: Open RSI's Games Library: which pledge grants your game access (new tab)
pledge.surchargeTitle: Original price: $1. Pledge value: $2. That is $3 ($4) more than the original price.

summary.title: Summary
summary.hidden: $1 of them hidden by search or filters

sidebar.label: Sidebar
sidebar.move: Drag to move the box (or use the arrow keys up and down)

filter.label: Filter pledges
filter.stateInclude: Showing only items with “$1”. Click: exclude them instead.
filter.stateExclude: Items with “$1” are excluded. Click: turn the filter off.

hints.ships: Pledges with a ship: standalone ships, packages and upgraded ships.
hints.warbond: Bought with money: the pledge has an order paid with money (not with store credit).
hints.rewards: Rewards with a value of $$0: event, referral, Concierge and other rewards.
hints.rewardsByName: Rewards, recognized by their names: event, referral, Concierge and other rewards.
hints.discount: Bought for less than the original price: ships and CCUs compared with RSI's ship prices, paints, gear and more with the Pledge Store. Pledges whose original price isn't known, or that cost more, don't count.

settings.languageHint: Automatic uses the browser language if the extension is translated into it, English otherwise.
settings.translateRsiTexts: Translate RSI's texts in the exchange and gift dialogs
settings.translateRsiTextsHint: By default these dialogs show RSI's own texts – introductions, acknowledgements, confirmations – in RSI's English, whose wording counts. Their translations are the Hangar Manager's own: changes RSI makes to its texts only reach them later, so they may not always be up to date.
settings.experimentalWarning: These features may not work as intended and can have consequences that can't be undone. Turning them on and using them is entirely at your own risk: the developer of the Hangar Manager accepts no liability for them.
settings.bulkMeltingHint: Exchanges all selected pledges of “My Hangar” at once, from the selection box of the sidebar, with your password entered once. Stops at the first pledge RSI refuses.
settings.hideMeltValueHint: Hides all $$ amounts: pledge values, discounts, the costs of applied upgrades, the amounts of the orders and the values in the exchange and gift dialogs.
settings.smartUpdatesHint: Checks the first, the last and a few more pages of the hangar and the buy back, and the newest orders, for changes: when the Hangar Manager is opened or shown again (at most at the interval below) and right after “My Gear”. The lists are updated without a full refresh.
settings.smartUpdatesLists: Check hangar, buy back and orders for changes
settings.smartUpdateIntervalHint: While the Hangar Manager is open in a visible tab ($1 to $2 minutes); a hidden tab checks again once it is shown. A shorter interval finds changes sooner, with more requests to RSI.
settings.spotChecks: Spot checks per check (only for changes within an existing pledge)
settings.spotChecksHint: Added or removed pledges are found by every check: page 1 and the last page show their number, and differences are searched for. The spot checks find changes within a pledge, e.g. new items or the gift status: with $1 of your $2 hangar pages, such a change shows in the next check with a chance of about $3, and after at most $4 checks for sure (about $5 at this interval while the Hangar Manager is open).
settings.spotChecksHintNoData: Added or removed pledges are found by every check: page 1 and the last page show their number, and differences are searched for. The spot checks find changes within a pledge, e.g. new items or the gift status, rotating through all pages. How likely such a change shows right away depends on the number of pages; it is shown here after the first load.
settings.spotChecksRange: $1 to $2. The buy back always takes one spot check, as its pages are much larger.
settings.storeRefresh: Read the warbond CCUs of the Pledge Store again after
settings.storeRefreshHint: The offers are stored and read again from RSI once they are older than this, while the Hangar Manager is open ($1 to $2 minutes). The refresh button and the initial load always read them. With smart updates off, only these do.
settings.storeItemsRefresh: Read the Pledge Store items again after
settings.storeItemsRefreshHint: The items of the Pledge Store (ships, gear, paints, …) are stored and read again from RSI once they are older than this, while the Hangar Manager is open ($1 to $2 minutes; about 13 requests each time). The refresh button always reads them; with smart updates off, they are read once a day.

buybackLinkOptions.list: The list page, scrolled to the pledge and highlighted

settings.privacy: Hide sensitive information (for screenshots or content creators)
settings.hidePledgeIds: Hide pledge and order IDs, name and address
settings.hidePledgeIdsHint: Hides the pledge IDs of all items, also those of applied upgrades, and the order IDs. Your name and billing address in the order details are made unreadable. Searching by ID still works.
settings.hideRefundHint: Hides for purchases paid with money how many of the $1 days for a refund are left, and the “Refund Request” button in the order details.
settings.demoModeHint: Shows only $1 pledges of “My Hangar” and $2 of the buy back, with made-up pledge IDs – e.g. for screenshots. Links to RSI and the cart do nothing meanwhile.
settings.themeHint: Only changes the look of the Hangar Manager; the rest of RSI's website stays as it is. “Modern Hangar” follows the system's light or dark appearance.

compactViewHint.modern: Shows the items as one list with separators instead of separate cards, so more of them fit on the screen.
compactViewHint.rsi: Shows the items without gaps, separated only by a 1 px border, so more of them fit on the screen.

settings.themedActionDialogs: Show the exchange and gift dialogs in the selected theme
settings.themedActionDialogsHint: Off: they look like RSI's own dialogs in “My Gear”, with the Hangar Manager's notes on the pledge and its value.
settings.filtersHint: Drag the filters (or use the arrows) to change their order; unchecked filters are not shown in the list.
settings.hideSupersededInsurances: Show only the best insurance of upgraded ships
settings.hideSupersededInsurancesHint: After upgrades a pledge lists the insurance of every step, but only the best one is kept: LTI if there is one, otherwise the most months. The others are hidden in the opened item.
settings.summaryTypes: Count the pledges per type in the summary
settings.summaryTypesHint: The “Summary” box then also shows how many ships, CCUs, paints, game packages and rewards are shown. The “Selected” box always shows this for the selected pledges.
settings.sidebarShowHint: Boxes below RSI's navigation on the left, on every tab of the manager.
settings.browserNotificationsHint: Also while no RSI page is open, e.g. when marked pledges can be melted. Off by default: turning it on opens a page where your browser asks for permission to display notifications; off gives the permission back. Only for this browser. The “Notifications” box of the sidebar works without it.
settings.browserNotificationsAsked: Your browser asks for the permission in the tab that just opened.
settings.browserNotificationsRefused: Your browser didn't allow notifications the last time, so they are off. Turn the setting on to be asked again.
settings.restorePaintNotificationsHint: The Paint Discount Consultant's notification (how many paints can be bought again with more discount) shows again for all paints, also those you dismissed with its ×. On all your browsers, as the dismissed paints are synced.
settings.sidebarOrderResetHint: Puts the boxes of the sidebar back into their default order. Which boxes are shown and which are collapsed stays as it is.
settings.sidebarNotificationsHint: Shown while there is a notification: when pledges marked to melt can be melted now – with buttons to show or select them – and the marked ones still waiting; how many paints can be bought again with more discount (dismissable with its ×). Notifications that can be checked off: one by one or all at once. No browser permission needed.
settings.sidebarSelectionHint: Shown while pledges are selected. Without it, the rows have no select control.
settings.sidebarPaintConsultantHint: Shown while paints can be bought again with a higher volume discount: how many, and the store credit it frees. Hidden while “Hide melt value” is on.
settings.consultantLayoutHint: How the consultant shows its plan: “Buy first” and “Melt first” as cards side by side – each with its discount, steps and store credit along the way – or the plan and its paints in tables.
settings.paintConsultantStoreCreditHint: The cart may also be paid with your current store credit. Off: only with what melting your own paints gives. The consultant always buys with store credit, never with new money.
settings.paintConsultantFillersHint: Buys cheap extra paints to reach a higher volume discount and melts them again after RSI's 24-hour cooldown. Off: only your own paints count toward the discount.
settings.paintConsultantGiftableHint: Paints that can be gifted now are not melted and bought again: bought with store credit, they would no longer be giftable. Also in the consultant itself.

reboughtDetectionOptions.plan: Only those of a plan put into the cart (safe)
reboughtDetectionOptions.guess: Also guess from discount and age

settings.reboughtDetectionHint: A paint counts as bought again – only its old pledge left to melt – when it was in a plan whose paints you put into the cart, and a copy with the discount was bought on that day or later. “Also guess” shows other pairs of an old pledge and a younger, discounted copy of the same paint as a guess to check; nothing is done with them.
settings.clearCacheHint: Deletes everything listed under “Stored data”, the whole copy the extension keeps in this browser. Nothing is changed in your hangar on RSI's website; the next refresh reads everything again.
settings.clearCacheConfirm:
Delete all data stored by the extension in this browser?

Your hangar on RSI's website stays as it is.
settings.clearCacheDone: Deleted. “$1” in “My Hangar” reads your hangar, buy back and orders again.
settings.resetSettingsHint: Sets all settings back to their defaults, on all devices they are synced to. The stored hangar stays.
settings.resetSettingsConfirm: Set all settings back to their defaults?
settings.resetSettingsDone: The settings are back to their defaults.
settings.repositoryHint: The source code of the extension.
settings.reportIssue: Report a bug or suggest a feature
settings.reportIssueHint: On GitHub. Please don't post personal data such as pledge or order IDs.
settings.privacyPolicyHint: Which data the extension handles and where it is kept.
settings.licenseHint: Open source, provided as is, without warranty.
settings.disclaimer: An unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloud Imperium Games or Roberts Space Industries.

storage.title: Stored data
storage.intro: What the extension keeps of RSI's data in this browser. Each can be deleted on its own; nothing changes on RSI's website.
storage.readAgainRefresh: The next refresh reads it again from RSI. Your hangar on RSI's website stays as it is.
storage.readAgainAuto: It is read again from RSI on its own as soon as the Hangar Manager is open.
storage.readAgainNever: It can't be read again: put the paints into the cart again to keep a new plan.

hangar.name: My Hangar
hangar.content: Pledges with their items, ship links and images
hangar.missing: Until then “My Hangar” offers the initial load, and the Pledge Store and the buy back miss your hangar.

buyback.name: Buy Back
buyback.content: Melted pledges and buy back tokens
buyback.missing: Until then the buy back is empty, and the Pledge Store can't count your buy back.

orders.name: Order history
orders.content: The order of every pledge, from the pledge log and the billing list
orders.missing: Until then refund tags, order details, the warbond filter and the search by order ID are missing. Reading it again takes the longest: hundreds of pages for large accounts.

ships.name: Ships
ships.content: All ships with standard price, image and Pledge Store link
ships.missing: Until then the discounts and the ship prices of applied upgrades are missing.

shipsBuyable.name: Ships on sale
shipsBuyable.content: SKUs and prices of the ships currently on sale

shipsWarbonds.name: Warbond offers
shipsWarbonds.content: Ships currently offered as warbond edition
shipsWarbonds.missing: Until then the Pledge Store shows no offers.

storeItems.name: Pledge Store items
storeItems.content: Ships, gear, packs, paints and more with category, price, image and link

storeCredit.name: Store credit
storeCredit.content: The account's store credit, as its account menu shows it
storeCredit.missing: Until then the top right of the manager shows no store credit.

paintPlan.name: Paint plan
paintPlan.content: The Paint Discount Consultant's plan whose paints were put into the cart: own and filler paints
paintPlan.missing: Until then the consultant doesn't know which filler paints were bought.

settings.name: Settings
settings.content: Language, theme, display and privacy options, filters, sorting
settings.missing: All settings go back to their defaults.

status.needsFullSync: Too many changes for a quick update.

ccugame.openInManagerBuyback: Open in Hangar Manager – Buy Back (#$1)

buyback.empty: RSI lists no buy back pledges for your account.
buyback.probablyGiftableHint: When bought back with real money (warbond), this item is probably giftable, as it was originally bought before $1.
buyback.tokensHint: Pledges you can still buy back with store credit (one token per pledge), as RSI shows them on “Buy Back Pledges” at the last refresh or check. Buying back with money needs no token.
buyback.addToCart: Add to cart on RSI and open the cart (new tab). RSI empties the cart for buy back pledges.
buyback.cartFailed: Could not add to the RSI cart: $1
buyback.cartNotFound: Not found at its stored position in RSI’s buy back any more – please sync and try again.

store.warbondIntro: Warbond upgrades that RSI's ship upgrade tool currently offers: the ship for less than its standard price, paid with new money. The discount is the same whichever ship you start from – the cheapest CCU starts from the most expensive ship below the warbond price.
store.loading: Reading the current offers from RSI …
store.failed: The offers couldn't be read from RSI: $1
store.refresh: Refreshes only the Pledge Store data here in the Hangar Manager – not your hangar, buy back or orders
store.empty: RSI currently offers no warbond CCUs.
store.openUpgradeHint: Opens RSI's ship upgrade dialog with the $1 (Warbond Edition) as target
store.sameShipBadgeHint: CCUs of your hangar straight to $1
store.collidingBadgeHint: Other CCUs of your hangar in this price range: they can't be chained with this warbond CCU (details when opened)
store.noBases: No ship costs less than the warbond price, so there is no CCU to it.
store.ownedHint: Every warbond CCU to this ship spans the prices from the warbond price to the standard price, whatever ship it starts from. These CCUs overlap that span, so they can't be chained with it. CCUs ending at or below the warbond price can, e.g. one to a ship listed above.
store.ownedNone: None of your CCUs overlap this price range.
store.cheapestHint: The discount is the same from every ship; the CCU from a more expensive ship costs less. The counts show how often you already have each ship – as ship or as target of a CCU – in your hangar and buy back.

consultant.title: Paint Discount Consultant
consultant.intro: RSI gives a volume discount on paints in the cart: 15 % from 2 paints up to 35 % from 10. Melt your paints that were bought with less, buy them again together with cheap filler paints at the higher discount, and melt the fillers again after 24 hours. You end up with more store credit – paid with store credit only, no new money.
consultant.hidden: Hidden while “Hide melt value” is on.
consultant.noItems: The paints of the Pledge Store aren't read yet.
consultant.noCredit: Your store credit isn't known yet, so it counts as $$0 here. It is read with the next refresh.
consultant.nothing: None of your paints can gain from a higher volume discount right now.
consultant.notEnough: No discount tier can be paid with store credit right now: $1 missing for $2 ($3 paints).
consultant.freedHint: What you gain once the filler paints are melted again. The melt value of your paints drops by the same amount: the total value of your account stays the same.
consultant.neededHint: What the cart costs beyond the melt value of your own paints.
consultant.cart: Cart: $1 for your paints + $2 for the filler paints, × $3 = $4.
consultant.payment: Paid with the $1 your paints give when melted, plus $2 of store credit.
consultant.result: After 24 hours the filler paints melt again for $1. Result: $2 more store credit, while the melt value of your paints drops from $3 to $4.
consultant.resultOwnOnly: Result: $1 more store credit, while the melt value of your paints drops from $2 to $3.
consultant.ownTitle: Your paints to melt and buy again ($1)
consultant.fillerTitle: Filler paints to buy and melt again after 24 hours ($1)
consultant.meltHint: What melting the pledge gives back as store credit.
consultant.stepOrder: Fill the cart and check it first – the final price, and that every paint you are going to melt is in it – and melt only after that.
consultant.stepCredit: Pay with store credit only. Paints you bought with money are giftable; bought again with store credit, they are bound to your account and no longer giftable (and lose a warbond status).
consultant.stepCooldown: RSI lets you melt a pledge only 24 hours after buying it, so the filler paints can be melted the next day.
consultant.stepPacks: Paint packs and pledges with a paint next to other items aren't included yet.
consultant.toCart: Put the $1 paints into the cart
consultant.toCartHint: Puts the own paints and the filler paints of this plan into your RSI cart and opens it. Nothing is bought: you check the cart and pay there.
consultant.cartOccupied: Your RSI cart already holds $1 items. Other items change the volume discount tier, so the plan wouldn't add up – empty the cart first, or add the paints anyway.
consultant.cartFailed: RSI refused some paints, so the cart doesn't match the plan. Check it before you melt anything:
consultant.cartDone: The paints are in the cart. Check the final price and every paint there before you melt anything, and pay with store credit only.
consultant.cartError: Reading or filling the cart failed: $1
consultant.meltHintCart: Put the paints into the cart first, and check it there: only then the own paints can be melted here.
consultant.meltHintReady: Melts the own paints of this plan at once (bulk melting). Opens a dialog first; check the cart before.
consultant.meltConsent: I put the paints of this plan into the cart and checked it there: the final price and that every paint I melt now is in it.
consultant.meltFirstHint: Melts the own paints before you buy them again (way 2): their store credit is free right away, and the consultant remembers which paints to buy again. Recommended is the other way: put the paints into the cart and buy first.
consultant.meltFirstConsent: I melt these paints before buying them again: I buy them again right away – nothing guarantees the price or that they are still sold until then.
consultant.pendingMelted: Own paints melted: their store credit is free
consultant.pendingBuy: Buy them again with $1 discount: $2 paints for $3
consultant.pendingNoTier: The store credit doesn't pay a tier with a discount now.
consultant.pendingMissing: For the planned $2, $1 of store credit is missing: the cart takes the best tier there is credit for.
consultant.pendingUnavailable: No longer sold on their own: $1
consultant.skipGiftableHint: Bought again with store credit, they would no longer be giftable.
consultant.giftableSkipped: $1 giftable paints that would gain are left out.
consultant.giftableTagHint: Giftable now; bought again with store credit, it no longer is.
consultant.markHint: Melt it and buy it again with the volume discount ($1 → $2): $3 of store credit freed. Opens the Paint Discount Consultant.
consultant.reboughtCart: Cart filled with the paints and the filler paints
consultant.reboughtPaidOn: Bought with the volume discount on $1
consultant.reboughtMelt: Melt the $1 old paints without the discount: $2 of store credit
consultant.reboughtSafe: Safe to melt: each of these paints is in your hangar once more, bought again with the volume discount. Melting the old pledge frees its melt value as store credit.
consultant.probablyRebought: $1 paints look bought again, but no plan of the consultant confirms it. Check them yourself before you melt anything – they stay in the plan:
consultant.probablyReboughtItem: $1: old pledge with $2, a younger copy with $3 ($4)
consultant.probablyReboughtOne: 1 paint looks bought again, but no plan of the consultant confirms it. Check it yourself before you melt anything – it stays in the plan:
consultant.reboughtMeltOne: Melt the old paint without the discount: $1 of store credit
consultant.meltOldHint: Melts the old pledges of the paints bought again at once (bulk melting). Opens a dialog first.
consultant.markMeltHint: This paint was bought again with $1 discount: melt this old pledge for $2 of store credit. Opens the Paint Discount Consultant.
consultant.boxMeltNowHint: Paints bought again with the volume discount: their old pledges are left to melt.
consultant.boxFilterHint: Shows only these paints in “My Hangar”; “Reset filters” or this button shows all again.
consultant.boxUnfilterHint: Turns the filter off: “My Hangar” shows all pledges again.

ways.intro: Buy your paints again at a higher volume discount – paid with store credit only.
ways.legendOwn: Your own paints, melted and bought again
ways.legendFiller: Filler paints to reach the tier – melt them again after 24 h
ways.titleLower: Two ways – with $1 both work, at different discounts
ways.titleImpossible: Two ways – with $1 only one works
ways.whyNeedsAria: Needs $1 before any paint is melted, you have $2
ways.whyBuyLowerAria: Pays the cart from your $1: the full tier would need $2, so it takes a cart for $3
ways.whyBuyImpossible: pays the whole cart before your paints are melted. Their $1 aren't free yet, so $2 are missing.
ways.whyBuyLower: pays the cart from your $1 before anything is melted. $2 would cost $3, so it takes $4 with $5 paints.
ways.whyMelt: turns your paints into $1 of store credit before paying. Your store credit covers the remaining $2.
ways.whyMeltAll: turns your paints into $1 of store credit before paying. That pays the whole cart.
ways.statUpfrontHint: Store credit needed before any paint is melted.
ways.stepCartCheck: Fill the cart and check it
ways.stepCartPlan: Fill the cart and save the plan
ways.stepCartPlanSub: Shows if every paint can be bought
ways.stepMeltTwiceSub: They are in the hangar twice now
ways.stepFillers: Melt the $1 filler paints after 24 h
ways.stepFillersOne: Melt the filler paint after 24 h
ways.hintSafe: Safe: your paints stay in the hangar until the new copies are bought.
ways.hintSafeLower: Your paints stay in the hangar until the new copies are bought. With $1 it reaches $2.
ways.hintImpossible: The cart is paid before your paints are melted, so their $1 can't help. $2 are missing.
ways.hintSame: Same result, but your paints leave the hangar before the new copies are bought.
ways.hintMelt: Your paints leave the hangar first. The saved plan remembers which ones to buy again.
ways.fillCart: Fill the cart and save the plan
ways.chartTitle: Your store credit along the way
ways.chartAria: Store credit after each step, starting at $1.
ways.noteCredit: Store credit only – never new money
ways.noteCooldown: Filler paints can be melted 24 h after buying.
ways.noteGiftable: Bought again, paints are no longer giftable
ways.notePacks: Paint packs are not included yet

fillers.ready: The $1 filler paints of the Paint Discount Consultant can be melted now. Open My Hangar to melt them.
fillers.readyOne: The filler paint of the Paint Discount Consultant can be melted now. Open My Hangar to melt it.
fillers.amongReady: $1 of them are filler paints of the Paint Discount Consultant.
fillers.amongReadyOne: 1 of them is a filler paint of the Paint Discount Consultant.
fillers.meltHint: Melts the filler paints the Paint Discount Consultant's order bought – by their pledge ids, never other copies of the same paint. Opens a dialog first.

upgradeLog.title: Applied upgrades
upgradeLog.empty: RSI lists no applied upgrades for this pledge.
upgradeLog.targetPriceHint: Original price of the target ship (RSI's ship upgrade tool)
upgradeLog.paidHint: What this upgrade added to the pledge value, i.e. what it really cost
upgradeLog.discountHint: Price difference of the two ships minus what the upgrade cost. Not known for the first upgrade: RSI doesn't log the value before it.

insurance.badgeTitle: Insurance – of several, only the best one counts

order.label: Order
order.title: Order #$1
order.invoiceDemo: Not available in demo mode: the invoice shows the real order.

refund.hint: Bought with money on $1: CIG refunds it within $2 days, until $3.
refund.requestHint: Opens RSI's support form in a new tab, filled in for a refund of order $1.
refund.leftLastDay: Last day for a refund: today ($1)

exchange.buttonHint: Exchange this pledge for store credit (melt it), as in “My Gear”. Opens a dialog first.
exchange.title: Exchange pledge

lastGameAccess.title: Last pledge with game access
lastGameAccess.text: This is the last pledge on your account that gives access to Star Citizen. Without it you can no longer play.

notBuybackable.title: No buy back
notBuybackable.text: This pledge is not eligible for reacquisition through the buy back: the exchange is permanent.

upgraded.title: Applied upgrades are exchanged, too
upgraded.text: The CCUs applied to this ship are exchanged with it and can't be separated again. What they saved you (warbond and sale prices) is relinquished.

discount.title: You give up a discount of $1 ($2)
discount.text: The original price is $1, this pledge is worth $2. A discounted price is permanently relinquished on exchange.

giftable.title: Giftable now
giftable.text: Bought back with store credit, the pledge is bound to your account and no longer giftable.

refundable.title: Refund still possible
refundable.text: $1. A refund pays back money, an exchange only store credit.

exchange.intro: You are about to exchange your “$1” pledge. This will remove the pledge, including any upgrades (such as customizations or CCUs) from your account, awarding $2 in store credit.
exchange.notBuybackable: This pledge is NOT ELIGIBLE for reacquisition through the BuyBack system. This exchange is permanent.
exchange.finalBuyback: This process is intended to be final, although some pledges may be available for reacquisition using the BuyBack system, if applicable and as long as the BuyBack system remains available. Items acquired with the use of store credits are BOUND TO YOUR ACCOUNT and non-giftable.
exchange.finalPermanent: This process is final. Items acquired with the use of store credits are BOUND TO YOUR ACCOUNT and non-giftable.
exchange.acknowledge: Please acknowledge the following before submitting:
exchange.consentLimited: Some limited availability items included or contained within the exchanged pledge are permanently relinquished.
exchange.consentDiscount: If this Pledge was made at a discounted price, the discounted price will be permanently RELINQUISHED on exchange.
exchange.consentWarnings: I have read the warnings above and still want to exchange this pledge.
exchange.password: Type in your password to confirm (sent to RSI only):
exchange.missing: Please acknowledge all points and type in your password.
exchange.successNote: The pledge leaves the list when you close this dialog; the buy back shows it after the next update.

bulkExchange.buttonHint: Exchange the selected pledges for store credit (melt them) at once. Opens a dialog first.
bulkExchange.disabledHint: “Bulk melting” is an experimental setting: turn it on to melt the selected pledges at once. Opens the settings at it.
bulkExchange.title: Exchange $1 pledges
bulkExchange.skipped: $1 selected can't be exchanged and are left out
bulkExchange.intro: You are about to exchange $1 pledges. This will remove them, including any upgrades (such as customizations or CCUs), from your account, awarding $2 in store credit. They are exchanged one after the other; the first one RSI refuses stops the rest.
bulkExchange.lastGameAccessText: The selection contains every pledge on your account that gives access to Star Citizen. Without them you can no longer play.

warnings.lastGameAccess: The selection takes all your game access
warnings.notBuybackable: $1 pledges can't be bought back: their exchange is permanent
warnings.upgraded: $1 pledges with applied upgrades: the CCUs are exchanged with them
warnings.discount: You give up discounts of $2 on $1 pledges
warnings.giftable: $1 pledges are giftable now, bought back they no longer are
warnings.refundable: $1 pledges can still be refunded for money

bulkExchange.consentWarnings: I have read the warnings above and still want to exchange these pledges.
bulkExchange.consentExperimental: I exchange these pledges with an experimental feature, at my own risk.
bulkExchange.success: $1 pledges exchanged, your ledger was credited with $2.
bulkExchange.successNote: They leave the list when you close this dialog; the buy back shows them after the next update.
bulkExchange.failed: RSI refused “$1”: $2. $3 more pledges were not sent and stay in your hangar.

meltMark.buttonHint: Mark this pledge to melt it later: the Hangar Manager tells you when RSI lets you melt it – 24 hours after buying it.
meltMark.hint: Marked to melt. RSI lets you melt a pledge 24 hours after buying it: from $1.

browserNotifications.title: Browser notifications
browserNotifications.intro: The Hangar Manager can tell you about changes with your browser's notifications, also while no RSI page is open – e.g. when pledges you marked to melt can be melted. For this, your browser asks you once for permission to display notifications.
browserNotifications.privacy: Nothing leaves your browser: the notifications are made in the extension itself. You can turn them off again any time in the settings of the Hangar Manager or of your browser.
browserNotifications.granted: Browser notifications are on – a first one should show now. You can close this tab.
browserNotifications.already: Browser notifications are already on. You can close this tab.
browserNotifications.refused: Your browser didn't allow it, so browser notifications stay off. Try again, or check whether your browser or system blocks notifications.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.meltReady: $1 marked pledges can be melted now
notifications.meltReadyOne: 1 marked pledge can be melted now
notifications.showReadyHint: Shows only these pledges in “My Hangar”; this button or “Reset filters” shows all again.
notifications.showAllHint: Turns the filter off: “My Hangar” shows all pledges again.
notifications.selectReadyHint: Selects these pledges: the “Selected” box then offers to melt them all at once (with “Bulk melting” on).
notifications.paintsRebuy: $1 paints can be bought again with more discount
notifications.paintsRebuyOne: 1 paint can be bought again with more discount
notifications.dismissPaintsHint: Removes this notification for exactly these paints. It comes back as soon as another paint can be bought again with more discount – then with the count of all of them.
notifications.browserHint: Browser notifications can tell you about changes also while no RSI page is open. Turn them on in the settings.
notifications.dismissBrowserHintHint: Removes this hint for good. You can turn browser notifications on in the settings any time.

gift.buttonHint: Gift this pledge to another citizen by email, as in “My Gear”. Opens a dialog first.
gift.title: Gift your pledge

lastGameAccess.title: Last pledge with game access
lastGameAccess.text: This is the last pledge on your account that gives access to Star Citizen. Once the gift is claimed, you can no longer play.

upgraded.title: Applied upgrades go with it
upgraded.text: The recipient gets the ship as it is now, including the CCUs applied to it.

gift.rules: Since $1, RSI has new gifting rules: pledges bought before can be gifted once (without store credit), newer ones only if they were bought as a gift.
gift.intro: You are about to gift your “$1” pledge to another citizen by email. This will transfer your pledge as soon as it is accepted by the recipient. You can cancel the gift at any time until then.
gift.noRegifting: Once your gift has been claimed it will be bound to the recipient's account and cannot be re-gifted.
gift.recipient: Who should we send this gift to?
gift.name: Recipient name
gift.emailRepeat: Recipient email again (to rule out typos)
gift.emailInvalid: This doesn't look like an email address.
gift.password: Please type your password to confirm (sent to RSI only):
gift.missing: Please fill in all fields; both email addresses must match.
gift.failed: The gift could not be sent: $1
gift.success: A gift email was sent to $1 for your pledge ($2).
gift.successNote: You can cancel the gift in “My Gear” anytime before it is claimed.
